subject: ddl: args v2 for create/alter/drop placement policy (#56186)
summary: Adds typed JobArgs v2 support for placement policy create/alter/drop by introducing `model.PlacementPolicyArgs` with v1/v2 encoding/decoding, switching executor submission to `doDDLJob2` (and setting job Version), and updating DDL workers to use `GetPlacementPolicyArgs`; includes unit test coverage for v1/v2 arg roundtrips.
